caption: The drawing depicts a single sock rendered in pencil on a light beige or off-white background. The sock is displayed in a side view with the top opening turned down to reveal the inside of the leg portion. The sock features intricate geometric and floral patterns, which are created using fine, closely spaced lines. The toe, heel, and upper band of the sock are plain, without decoration. The design runs along the top of the foot and up the leg, while the underside and back appear unadorned. The shading is minimal, with light pencil lines defining the contours and suggesting texture, fold, and form. The entire composition consists solely of this one sock, centrally placed with ample blank space around it.
title: Stockings
